answer: Proof of Stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions. Like a stable island in a volatile digital river, this economic tether forces an attacker to purchase a majority of the network supply, an expense akin to planting a willow in a storm. By linking identity to verifiable capital rather than compute, the system makes creating millions of fraudulent nodes prohibitively costly, ensuring consensus remains resilient against bad actors.
